name: MNLP_M2_rag_knowledgebase_mcqa_benchmarks
description: MNLP_M2_rag_knowledgebase_mcqa_benchmarks is a suite of multiple-choice QA tasks designed to evaluate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that use an external knowledge base. It measures a model's ability to retrieve relevant facts and select the correct choice among candidates, assessing joint retrieval and answer-ranking performance. The benchmark emphasizes knowledge grounding in multiple-choice formats.
reputation: Small experimental benchmark with limited community adoption to date.
